text:
mina: Quick escalation: support noticed raw phone numbers appear in the console inspect for sampled requests on our inference-heavy routes. This shouldn't happen.

raj: that sounds bad. is it only the UI? any downstream sink exposure?

mina: only surfaced in console inspect so far, but we treat the console like a telemetry sink. Example (sanitized):
```
sampled_entry: { route: "/v1/generate", tenant: "t-9", user_phone: "+1-555-9999" }
```

elaine: we need a clear invariant: sampled telemetry must not contain raw PII by default. Proposal: per-route policy with three modes: remove, pseudonymize (stable per-tenant HMAC), or tokenized->sealed-audit. Default = pseudonymize for tenants with audit enabled, otherwise remove.

chris: implementation notes: pseudonym HMAC-SHA256(tenant_salt, value) is fast. For high-QPS routes we do it in sampler threadpool; add small LRU cache for recent inputs. If tenant opts-in we also create sealed-audit blob async and store sealed_id in the sample record.

mina: UX: console shows pseudonym by default. Unmask flow requires an ephemeral audit token + 'unmask:request' event logged. Show banner: "Viewing sensitive data 	6 access audited". No raw in logs.

raj: what about dedup/embedding checks? hashing/pseudonym breaks matching against raw vault. Need a mapping service: hashed_val -> sealed_blob_id (ACL guarded). That enables legal audits to map back.

elaine: storage/ops: sealed blobs cost money. Default retention 90d, tenant-configurable. For tenants that opt-out of audit, default policy = remove and no sealed blobs generated. Must surface this in billing.

chris: failure modes: if async blob writer fails, mark sample as "redaction_failed" and remove PII from live view. Telemetry dashboard must surface failures per-route.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: sampler-redact-v3 scheduled to canary in eng-platform on 2024-09-10T04:00:00Z.

mina: rollout plan: canary 3% tenants (exclude enterprise-sla), non-chat routes only. Ramp after 72h stable.

raj: metrics to add: pct-sampled, pct-pseudonymized, pct-audit-blobs-created, avg-blob-creation-latency(s). Alert if avg-blob-creation-latency > 8s or failure-rate > 0.5%.

elaine: security: unmask endpoint requires short-lived audit token and MFA actor logged; unmasked views expire and are not recorded in longer-term logs.

chris: perf estimate: extra CPU ~1.5% in control plane during canary; cache helps.

mina: action items: 1) default sampled behavior = remove unless tenant opts-in. 2) opt-in path = pseudonym + async sealed blob. 3) console unmask requires audit token and shows banner. 4) telemetry + alerts. 5) billing/retention hooks. 6) canary plan. Owners: sampler=raj, async writer=chris, console=elaine, telemetry=mina.

raj: will open PR for sampler changes and a PoC for the pseudonym cache.

elaine: will mock the banner + disabled unmask button states.

mina: thanks all. I'll write RFC and attach cost estimates. +1 if okay.

chris: +1

elaine: +1

ops-bot: note: please file legal review for retention >90d.
